skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recognize the historical context of the emergence, development, and succession of economic theory schools.
Understand the inheritance and differences in content and methodology among economic theory schools.
Evaluate the achievements and limitations of economic theories and derive theoretical and practical significance.
Gain necessary knowledge for effective operation in a market economy, maximizing profits, and contributing to national economic development.
Develop logical economic thinking to enhance research quality and solve practical problems after graduation.
Apply economic theories to specific conditions, understand current achievements and limitations in economic development, and propose effective solutions.
Develop independent work skills and teamwork abilities.
Develop self-study abilities to complete assigned tasks and assignments.
